planting.note: Set divisions or container plants out in spring once soil has warmed, in average, well-drained garden soil in full sun to shade.

directions: Glow Sticks is a tall fescue selection grown for dark green, strap-like foliage that stays attractive year-round, topped in mid-spring by luminous yellow flower spikelets that rise above the clump like small torches. Unusually for the species, it performs equally well in bright sun or considerable shade, making it a flexible filler for mixed borders, mass plantings, or naturalized slopes. Deep, strong roots make established clumps drought-tolerant and largely self-sufficient once settled in. Divide congested clumps in spring if flowering declines or the center of the clump thins out.
